title: M365 Con 27: Free Online Microsoft Conference for Business Central, Dynamics 365 & Microsoft 365 Professionals
summary: M365 Con 27 is a free online community conference running January 11-22, 2027, with 10 topic days covering Microsoft technologies including Business Central, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, and AI. Day 2 focuses specifically on Business Apps, making it valuable for developers, consultants, architects and professionals across the Microsoft ecosystem.
key_points: M365 Con 27 is a free, online, community-driven event with 10 topic days across the Microsoft technology stack
Day 2 specifically covers Business Apps including Dynamics 365 and Business Central with sessions for developers, consultants, architects and partners
The conference brings together Microsoft MVPs, practitioners and experts to share real-world solutions and practical experiences
Modern Business Central implementations rarely exist in isolation, so learning about surrounding technologies like Power Platform, Azure and AI is valuable
The event serves multiple roles including developers, administrators, architects, consultants and decision-makers

quotes.text: M365 Con 27 is a community-run Microsoft technology conference designed around practical sessions rather than traditional marketing presentations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the focus on real-world knowledge sharing from active practitioners rather than vendor marketing

quotes.text: A Business Central implementation, for example, might involve: Business Central → APIs → Power Platform → Dataverse → Microsoft 365 → Azure → AI.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates why understanding the broader Microsoft ecosystem beyond just Business Central is essential for modern implementations
